title: Well and House
author: Lior Galloway
blurb: Hazel Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
